The Riot Dogs

The Riot Dogs are a powerhouse 3–4 piece with epic vocals, killer chemistry, and a riotous blend of rock, punk, alt, soul & pop. Bold, loud, and unforgettable.

About The Riot Dogs

The Riot Dogs are a high-impact 3-piece (expandable to a 4-piece) delivering a dynamic, genre-blending setlist packed with rock, punk, alternative, soul, and pop bangers. With a magnetic blend of powerhouse vocals, razor-tight musicianship, and undeniable chemistry , they electrify every stage they hit. Fronted by the charismatic Sam —a real-life music teacher by day and weekend frontman with serious Jack Black vibes —the band is known for their versatile voice , infectious energy, and ability to get any room moving. He’s joined by Ewan on bass and backing vocals, and Emanuele on drums and backing vocals—together bringing deep grooves, pro-level experience, and a tight, intuitive feel. Want to amp up the sound even more? Add Teo on lead guitar or saxophone for that extra punch. Whether it’s a dance floor singalong or a full-throttle alt-rock moment , The Riot Dogs deliver with over 100 songs and the kind of road-tested performance chops that only come from years on stage together. From cruise ships to club nights, they’ve supported major acts and played everywhere from Notting Hill Carnival to the Jazz Café. Expect friendly communication , a customisable setlist , and the option to add live DJing for maximum impact. The Riot Dogs bring the energy—so you can bring the party.
